# spotlight_team (Data Source)

A team in a Spotlight workspace, read by its key, for configuration that uses a team another configuration manages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spotlight_workspace" "acme" {
  slug = "acme"
}

data "spotlight_team" "core" {
  workspace_id = data.spotlight_workspace.acme.id
  key          = "core"
}

resource "spotlight_skill" "core_grafana" {
  team_id = data.spotlight_team.core.id
  key     = "grafana"
  files = {
    "SKILL.md" = file("${path.module}/skills/grafana/SKILL.md")
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The team's key, as in `core`.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace the team belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the team within its workspace, as in `core`.
- `id` (String) The id Spotlight issued the team.
- `name` (String) What the team is called.
